messages.subject: areaplot issues
parts:

This is my first attempt to use ggplot2 and I could not figure out, what mistake I made here.

This is my data as an example (the data is big so I am coping only few lines) the data has proportion of  7 landcover types for 30 years

here is my code, where I am plotting the data:


ggplot(a1b1, aes(x=Year, y=Area, fill=Landcover)) +
    geom_area(colour="black", size=.2, alpha=.4) + scale_fill_manual(values=my_col) 


But, I am getting this output, would some one knows what I am missing?

Thanks a lot in advance

No idea really. It works fine for me up to the scale_fill_manual and since you did not include it it's hard to say if that is the problem.  BTW, the best way to provide sample data is with the dput() function. Otherwise an excellently posed question

parts:
Never mind. I solved the problem. Thanks a lot to John for the tips. 
I added these two line before ggplot()

mydata1 = data.frame(mydata$Year, mydata$Landcover, as.numeric(as.character(mydata$Area)))
colnames(mydata1) = c("Year","Landcover","Area")

Thank you.
